   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 17 jul 2026 - 26 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Ariel Brnssn_, 2 ago 2026, 1/5: "Tiene algunos bug la app. No deja poner fotos en las caratulas"
            2. _Philip Wattis_, 26 sept 2026, 3/5: "App seems a bit buggy. It has stopped writing heart rate data to Health Connect, meaning this important metric does not sync up in other health apps."
            3. _Kampung New TV_, 25 sept 2026, 4/5: "Find Phone is broken in version 3.59.1i The “Find Phone” feature on my Xiaomi Mi Band 7 stopped working after updating to Mi Fitness 3.59.1i. The band would remain stuck on “Just a sec…” and my phone would not ring. Bluetooth connection was working normally, and the phone could still successfully find the Mi Band.
